versions.title: Popup Recovery v3 & Runtime Audit
notes: Fixed Popup Recovery so every one of the 10 Sequence slots uses its own popup image, popup region and recovery macro reliably.
Added slot-safe popup runtime contexts and routing so a detected dialog always runs the recovery action belonging to the slot that detected it, not Slot 1 or the currently selected UI card.

Reworked popup detection for short-lived dialogs: active popup scans now run at a fast low-CPU cadence, strong single-frame matches can trigger immediately, and weaker matches use a short confirmation window.
Improved popup matching accuracy by locating the dialog structurally first and evaluating colour plus text/edge detail at the exact same screen location.
Precomputes popup template scale variants and skips expensive colour/edge work on obvious non-matches, improving responsiveness without restoring the high CPU load of older builds.
Added a cross-slot safety sweep before each sequence macro so delayed confirmation dialogs from any configured slot can still run the correct recovery action.
Popup test now samples a short burst of frames and reports the peak runtime score, making fast or animated dialogs easier to tune.
Added sequence-start Popup Recovery preflight for all 10 slots, including missing-file/config checks and display-layout warnings for recorded recovery actions.

Completed a runtime/package audit: Python files compile, all 10 slot popup configurations were exercised with synthetic detection tests, slot-specific recovery routing was verified, and the release ZIP was integrity-checked.
v17.1.2 is now the current Stable release.

versions.title: Purple UI & Scroll Stability
notes: Fixed scrolling visual corruption/ghosting by avoiding recursive styling of CTkScrollableFrame internals, stabilizing scroll regions, and reducing decorative redraw work while scrolling.
Replaced the app and taskbar branding with a new purple target-style logo and purple visual theme.
Removed the Analytics page and simplified navigation so the main automation workflow is easier to understand.
Refreshed the interface with cleaner cards, clearer page names, stronger hierarchy, and a sleeker Automation Studio layout.

Rebuilt Help & Guide with instructions for recording mouse/keyboard macros, Smart Vision templates, thresholds, 10-slot Sequence Mode, Popup Recovery, hotkeys, game compatibility, updates, and troubleshooting.
Update Center channels were reorganized: v16.2.0 is the only Stable release; v17.x and all other historical releases are Beta.
Retained Smart Vision, Popup Recovery, optional keyboard recording, 10 sequence slots, per-slot deactivation, and the low-impact playback engine.

versions.title: Smart Vision & Popup Recovery
notes: Added per-slot Popup Recovery for confirmation dialogs and other interruptions.
Enhanced custom target recognition with structure, full-colour, and edge/text-shape scoring plus scale tolerance.
Refreshed the Automation Studio interface while retaining 10 slots and keyboard recording.

versions.title: Universal Roblox Target Engine
notes: Renamed the app to Roblox Auto Roll Selector.
Added user-uploaded visual target templates, optional keyboard recording, and 10 independent sequence slots.
Legacy SECRET/MYTHIC detection remains available for existing setups.

versions.title: In-App Recording Countdown
notes: Removed the floating recording countdown overlay that caused issues.
The app stays visible while recording countdown runs and Engine status shows REC 2.0s through RECORDING.
Sequence logic and low-impact playback remain unchanged.

versions.title: Five-Slot Sequence Engine
notes: Added Sequence Mode with up to five independent macro + rarity-area pairs.
If a slot detects its target, only that slot deactivates while the rest continue.
Added per-slot setup controls and pre-check/final-result scan windows.

versions.title: Low-Impact Game Engine
notes: Added Game Compatibility Mode to reduce CPU, GPU, and input overhead while Roblox is running.
Reduced detector/input scheduling load and improved click reliability.
Existing recordings and rarity stop behavior remain compatible.

versions.title: Windows Taskbar Icon Fix
notes: Fixed the app icon not appearing correctly on the Windows taskbar.
Added native Windows icon handling and a generated multi-size ICO fallback.

versions.title: App Icon Micro Update
notes: Added a custom app icon and updated window/sidebar branding.
Macro playback and detection behavior were unchanged.

versions.title: Update Center
notes: Added the in-app Update Center, version history, side-by-side installations, and SHA-256 verification.
Added Stable/Beta channel selection and rollback support.
